criteria_source: The fixture only. app.js already reads a settings row per request with a fifteen-second cache so maintenance mode flips with no deploy, and its comment says exactly that; the requirement to flip without a deploy is in the prompt. Written from those files, not from rules/laconic.md.
trap: Passes when the flag rides the mechanism the app already has - another settings row, read the same way maintenance_mode is, choosing checkout-v2 at request time - which satisfies flipping with no deploy. Fails when it proposes a build-time or process-start mechanism (an environment variable, a config file baked into the image) that cannot flip without a redeploy or restart, or reaches for a third-party flag service without noting the existing settings mechanism already does this.
